title: Notification Channels for Android O/API level 26
symptom: On Android 8.0, applications must support notification channels for users to change the priority and importance of notifications. The app currently does not support notification channels, limiting user control over notification behavior.
fix: Notification Channels support is now present in the nightlies.
evidence_quote: I will mark this issue as resolved as the Notifications Channels support is now present in the nightlies.
